crops.text: Purchase Cost: 2 Points(1GCD)(OYT) Can cook a healing item to increase its healing value by 1, or put two healing items in to combine them into one item with all of their effects combined, with a star level equal to that of the highest involved item. You can then add one of the following additional effects to that new item:3T2 Regen2T2 EmpoweredFor 2 turns, attacks inflict 2T Smoldering
